preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Assign the foreach output to an array variable, then pipe the variable.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Reject wrappers containing a closing foreach block immediately followed by a pipeline token.
preferred_methods.rollback: Return to separate scalar probes if the assigned-array form changes output semantics.
preferred_methods.title: Preassign PowerShell statement-loop output before piping
trigger_preconditions: statement-level foreach output must feed another pipeline

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Run bounded local revision probes first and one separate live ls-remote probe second.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not place ls-remote and broad worktree status in the same timed wrapper.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the previous verified receipt and stop without mutation if either bounded probe fails.
preferred_methods.title: Separate live-remote equality from local source verification
trigger_preconditions: live-remote lookup and local checks combined

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Check HEAD, branch, upstream, and ancestry separately; then run one dedicated status command.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Keep broad status as its own command with a dedicated timeout budget.
preferred_methods.rollback: Use diff, cached-diff, and bounded untracked probes only as partial evidence until full status completes.
preferred_methods.title: Separate broad worktree cleanliness from ancestry arithmetic

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Run the native ancestry command first, capture its exit code in a scalar, then construct the PowerShell object.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not embed native commands with statement separators inside hash-literal value expressions.
preferred_methods.rollback: Use one scalar probe per command and stop without mutation if any exit code is nonzero.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local PowerShell and Git evidence only.
preferred_methods.title: Capture native exit codes before PowerShell object construction
trigger_preconditions: native command success must be included in a structured receipt

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read each subcommand help, use record and witness with their exact file options, then inspect current state before requesting a transition.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Interrogate exact help and current ledger state before every Method Flow mutation.
preferred_methods.rollback: Stop after a failed transition, inspect the ledger, and apply only the missing state change.
preferred_methods.title: Use exact Method Flow subcommands and inspect auto-transition state
trigger_preconditions: Method Flow ledger append or promotion
runner interface or current method state is not already materialized in context

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Resolve the phase root against the repository before invoking the Meta Tool Box build command.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Pass an absolute repository-bound phase root and require the expected nonzero card count before credit.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the zero-card refusal, change only the path binding, and rerun the bounded catalogue step.
preferred_methods.title: Bind Meta Tool Box phase roots to the repository
trigger_preconditions: caller shell working directory differs from repository root

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read aggregate chain counts from the frozen provenance index and proposal rows from the proposal ledger.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Resolve each count from its declared frozen authoritative artifact before writing a validator assertion.
preferred_methods.rollback: Leave the frozen x1 files unchanged and correct only the validator lookup.
preferred_methods.title: Bind aggregate assertions to their frozen authoritative artifact
trigger_preconditions: a validator combines row-level and aggregate proposal evidence

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Classify exact scanner implementation files as definition surfaces while continuing to scan every public payload file.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Keep a minimal exact scanner-definition allowlist and report it separately from confirmed payload hits.
